crates.name: psx-rt
crates.purpose: Bare-metal runtime: `_start`, BIOS calls, panic, heap, VBlank IRQ counter, corrected i64 builtins, scratchpad regions and scratchpad stacks.

crates.name: psx-io
crates.purpose: Volatile MMIO primitives for target code, plus the CD-ROM command surface.

crates.name: psx-gpu
crates.purpose: High-level GPU API: init, primitives, framebuffers, display-window shifting.

crates.name: psx-vram
crates.purpose: Typed VRAM layout primitives: color, rect, tpage, CLUT, upload helpers.

crates.name: psx-spu
crates.purpose: High-level SPU API: typed voices, volume, pitch, ADSR, ADPCM upload, key-on/off, loop chaining, noise.

crates.name: psx-sfx
crates.purpose: One-shot sample banks, voice allocation and playback cutoff for SPU effects.

crates.name: psx-settings
crates.purpose: Versioned game preferences with optional memory-card persistence.

crates.name: psx-gte
crates.purpose: GTE (COP2) wrappers. MIPS emits inline-asm coprocessor ops; host routes through `psx-gte-core`.

crates.name: psx-gte-core
crates.purpose: Pure-Rust GTE state machine and fixed-point math. Shared by `psx-gte` and the emulator; bit-exact against a real-console conformance corpus.

crates.name: psx-math
crates.purpose: Fixed-point math: Q0.12 angles + sin/cos/atan2, int32 helpers, decimal text formatting.

crates.name: psx-pad
crates.purpose: SIO0 controller polling: digital + DualShock analog, `PadTracker` edges/repeat, diagnostic pacing.

crates.name: psx-tick
crates.purpose: Fixed-timestep game clock: per-game tick rate and catch-up policy, a render phase for interpolation, and consistency counters. Callers pass the VBlank count, so every rule is host-testable.

crates.name: psx-font
crates.purpose: Bitmap-font atlas: 1bpp source → 4bpp CLUT VRAM texture, GP0 textured-rect draw path.

crates.name: psx-fx
crates.purpose: Arcade-style visual effects: particle pools, screen shake, deterministic RNG.

crates.name: psx-asset
crates.purpose: Runtime parsers for cooked-asset blobs. Consumes `psxed-format` layouts produced by the editor.

crates.name: psx-cache
crates.purpose: Generic no_std slot cache: keyed residency pool with LRU eviction and pinning.

crates.name: psx-mc
crates.purpose: Memory-card driver: SIO0 transport, on-card filesystem format interoperable with the console's card manager, optional LZSS compression.

crates.name: psx-osk
crates.purpose: On-screen keyboard for pad-driven text entry: QWERTY/symbols pages, shift, PS4-style boxed keys.

crates.name: psx-pack
crates.purpose: Guest-side WORLD.PAK parsing + in-place HLZC/LZ4 decompression (reader half of `psx-iso`).

crates.name: psx-telemetry
crates.purpose: Shared guest/host telemetry id tables for the emulator profiling hooks.

crates.name: psx-fmv
crates.purpose: FMV playback building blocks: STR sector demux, BS v2 bitstream to MDEC run-length decode, MDEC upload/decode via DMA0/DMA1 (guest only), ISO9660 root-file lookup.

examples.name: hello-spstack
examples.shows: A call tree run on a scratchpad stack under VBlank IRQs, checked against the RAM stack; `tools/stack_guard.py` proves it fits.

examples.name: hello-gteirq
examples.shows: RTPS run under VBlank IRQs, checking that psx-rt's handler never runs a GTE command twice. The emulator models this since its commit c7e3ea8; a console run remains the reference.

examples.name: hello-present
examples.shows: psx-rt's queued display flip, held until the frame's closing GP0(1Fh) sets GPUSTAT bit 24 (`arm_draw_done`, `end_with_draw_done`, `signal_draw_done`).

examples.name: hello-fmv
examples.shows: FMV console test: streams a 2x STR with XA audio, decodes it with `psx-fmv`, and shows sector counts (LOST/BAD) over the video.

examples.name: hello-memcard
examples.shows: Non-destructive memory-card diagnostic: reads and hashes all 1024 frames, then (L1+R1+Cross) writes and verifies one test save.

examples.name: hello-memprobe
examples.shows: Checks psx-rt's `memcpy`/`memset`/`memcmp` against reference loops for every size and alignment; prints `MEMPROBE PASS` or `FAIL`.

examples.name: hello-pack
examples.shows: `psx_pack::cd` smoke test: streams raw and compressed WORLD.PAK chunks off the disc and checks them.

examples.name: hello-i64probe
examples.shows: Runs software 64-bit multiply/divide/modulo on the target and checks the results; covers psx-rt's `__divdi3`/`__moddi3` overrides.

examples.name: cdda-read-contention
examples.shows: CD-ROM conformance probe: issues a data read while CD-DA is playing and records which IRQ the drive raises.
